subject: URGENT: Booth B12 intermittent brownouts — keynote 11:30 at risk / contingency
messages:
From: David Alvarez <ops@grandhallvenue.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: Booth B12 intermittent brownouts — keynote 11:30 at risk

Hey Soojin —

Quick heads-up from the floor: Booth B12 (Hall B, row 3) has had three short brownouts this morning; the panel feeding that run shows voltage dips around 07:50 and 08:05 (attached log). The vendor stand is reporting laptops rebooting and the LED rig cycling. We are routing a tech now but wanted to flag ASAP since your keynote with J.K. Thomas is scheduled for 11:30 in the adjacent demo theater and the AV feed for the keynote relies on the same distribution path.

I attached the preliminary power log and a photo of the breaker box (on-site-photo-1.jpg). Tech ETA ~ 45–60 minutes; if the brownouts continue we can isolate circuits but that may interrupt other booths.

I know this is short notice — please advise if you want venue to preemptively pull the AV feed to the main stage or set the keynote up for remote delivery.

— David

I'll loop sponsor if needed.

Hi team —

Tech (Connor) is en route, ETA 40 minutes. Initial triage from our remote monitor indicates a failing contactor in the hall distribution panel; often causes short voltage sags under load. We can isolate the faulty contactor and swap to a bypass but that requires a 20–30 minute window and a short outage while we switch.

We attached an emergency service quote (vendor-quote-powerrestore.xlsx) and a UPS availability pdf (ups-availability.pdf). If you approve emergency service we can proceed immediately; otherwise we'll monitor and respond if it repeats.

Regards,
Elena Park
Operations Lead, PowerRestore Co
dispatch@powerrestore.io

Hi J.K. —

Quick note from Redwood event ops: the venue is experiencing intermittent brownouts in Hall B where the demo theater is fed. We're setting up a contingency but need to confirm a backup plan. Can you: 
1) Confirm you can present remotely via Zoom if we move to remote-only at 11:30 (we can route slide deck and Q&A).
2) Share a 5-minute intro slide deck and a short bio we can put in the app if we switch.

If you prefer to do an in-person talk, would you accept a 25–30 minute delay (we may need to isolate and switch circuits)?

Thanks — we aim to decide by 10:30 to give the audience and sponsor notice.

Best,

Subject: Re: URGENT: Booth B12 intermittent brownouts — keynote 11:30 at risk — POSTMORTEM + actions

Status update and closure:
- PowerRestore isolated the failing contactor at 10:42 and completed bypass work; short outage (2 minutes) while switching. Post-fix monitoring (30m) shows stable feed.
- Venue loaned two UPS units to B12 and one to the AV feed during the repair window. UPS serials noted in incident doc.
- J.K. presented remotely at 11:30 (slides used; Q&A via chat). Audience notified in-app at 11:15; sponsor announcer covered in-person.
- Sponsor (ACME) accepted the contingency and we offered a 10% credit on activation fee (she confirmed OK).

Attachments uploaded to shared drive: incident photos, venue power log, vendor invoice (linked). Action items:
1) Finance to approve emergency PO and process PowerRestore invoice (Dev).
2) Events to update the field checklist to include two spare UPS on site for Hall B (Marissa/Tessa).
3) Create a short FAQ for speakers about rapid remote fallback and circulate in the speaker prep packet (Soojin).

Thanks to David and Elena for fast response and to the team for rapid coordination. Logging this thread to the incident binder.

— Soojin
